claims: The #7 seed Miami Hurricanes defeated the #10 seed Missouri Tigers 80-66.
The game was in the first round of the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
Malik Reneau scored 24 points for the Miami Hurricanes.
Jayden Stone scored 21 points for the Missouri Tigers.
The Miami Hurricanes advanced to the second round.
The game was at Enterprise Center, St. Louis, MO.
The halftime score was Miami Hurricanes 27, Missouri Tigers 26.
Tre Donaldson scored 17 points for the Miami Hurricanes.
Shelton Henderson scored 15 points for the Miami Hurricanes.
Mark Mitchell scored 19 points for the Missouri Tigers.
The Miami Hurricanes outrebounded the Missouri Tigers 46-30.
The Miami Hurricanes had a late 11-0 run in the second half.
